title.narrative: WOMENS ACCESS TO THE GREEN ECONOMYIN THE WEST AND CENTRAL AFRICA

description.narrative: The Women’s Access to the Green Economy in West and Central Africa, implemented by UN Women aims to contribute to supporting women’s participation in the green economy. The objectives of the grant are to enhance directly the capacity of 200 women-led SMEs and representatives from women’s associations to access information and tools to access green finance and support the development. The project will also pilot a mechanism to facilitate women-led business and grassroots women’s groups access to innovative and green finance. Such mechanism will be piloted in Senegal with the Network of Female Rice Producers of the North of Senegal (circa 15,000 members). The project will also contribute to direct capacity building of 100 policymakers (from ECOWAS Member States) to identify and integrate gender in green finance policies and strategies and build advocacy capabilities of young women members of the West African Young Women’s network in the area of green finance. The key activities include institutional strengthening and capacity building of women-led businesses and women entrepreneurs to participate in the green economy and to access green finance in West Africa. It also supports policymakers and advocates in regional institutions and ECOWAS Member States to understand gender considerations in green transition in relation to women’s access to green finance which can support a more favourable enabling environment for women entrepreneurs in the medium term.
